sections.title: Executive verdict
sections.text: Active Infrastructures is a small EPC contractor with a growing real-estate capital allocation, not simply a residential developer. sections.title: Research header, identity and gates
sections.text: NSE SME ACTIVEINFR, ISIN INE0KLO01025,1.5015016 crore shares of₹5 face value. The March 2025 IPO issued 43,00,200 shares at₹181; no FY 2026 fresh issue was reported. Accounts are consolidated Ind AS, with separate parent statements and material minority interests. Cutoff October 20,2026; five-year nominal INR scenarios and 15% equity hurdle before personal taxes. G 1 conditional: disclosed RPT/funding and audit considerations without a proven severe integrity failure. G 2 hold: a material FY 2024 comparative P&L inconsistency remains, although newer main statements reconcile and bounded adverse quality assessments are possible. G 3 conditional: post-March property funding/FD availability not established. G 4 implementation hold for₹5 lakh reference size, not an assertion the stock is suspended.

sections.title: Scorecard and audit
sections.text: GOV 4, MOAT 4, REV 2, DUR 5, CAP 3, CASH 3, BAL 4, EXEC 4, EARN 4. BQS=.20×4+.20×4+.12×2+.10×5+.12×3+.10×3+.08×4+.08×4=3.64. Growth Quality=.40×2+.20×5+.15×4+.15×3+.10×3=3.15; persistent CAP/CASH cap 5 does not bind. IAS uses Q 3.64, R NS, D 2, P 3 and L 1. Known weighted sum 1.71 at 65% coverage gives missing-data bounds 2.06–5.21, not a numeric IAS. No missing-factor reweighting or hidden score haircut. All rankings are excluded. GOV/CASH±1 changes BQS by.20/.10; CAP/EARN±1 changes GQS by.15 each. Conditional judgments assess the evidence, not the precision of disputed historical profit.

sections.title: Business overview and economic drivers
sections.text: The group executes roads, bridges, water networks and civil/institutional construction while holding and developing real estate. Parent EPC is supplemented by 50.5%-owned Digvijay Shradha Infrastructure, wholly owned Achievers Ventures, and 67%-owned Solus and Stargate LLPs. The May 2026 Raghukul Shradha Realty LLP is 50.5% owned through Achievers, not wholly owned. FY 2026 infrastructure segment sales₹94.224 crore grew from₹69.0006, while real-estate sales fell from₹20.7567 to₹2.3425, primarily rental/maintenance income rather than property sales. Consolidated headline growth therefore hides a mix shift. Project certification, customer payment, retention and land monetization determine cash generation; subsidiaries and partner interests must not be valued as 100%-owned earnings.

sections.title: Moat and industry position
sections.text: Qualification, technical execution and group relationships provide some access to water/road and institutional projects, but no strong pricing power or scale advantage is established. At the IPO, top three customers accounted for 96.54% ofFY 2024 revenue and top ten 99.94%; H 1 FY 2025 corresponding figures 95.79% and 99.95%. Those dated concentrations are not relabeled current FY 2026 figures. Top-ten suppliers were 40.10% ofFY 2024 purchases and 50.40% in H 1 FY 2025. Government infrastructure budgets provide demand opportunities, not guaranteed awards, margins or payment. The related Jain Engineering Works India relationship is economically significant: annual disclosures include₹22.5446 crore parent contract receipts plus subsidiary sales, whose exact grouped total requires careful reading rather than assuming customer diversification.

sections.title: Revenue growth and scale
sections.text: Historical restated group sales FY 2022/2023/2024/2025/2026:₹1.1008/89.3983/97.1833/89.7574/96.5665 crore. The hugeFY 2023 step reflects changed subsidiaries and property recognition, not a comparable organic growth rate. Original FY 2021 consolidated revenue was₹.7621569 crore, in accounts presented in hundreds of rupees; using it mechanically would exaggerate a five-year growth score. Preselected post-step FY 2023–2026 CAGR is 2.60%, mapping to REV 2. FY 2025 declined 7.64% andFY 2026 recovered 7.59%. Parent sales₹41.8267 versus₹36.0702 and parent profit growth are not substituted for group performance. Ownership also changed: Achievers increased from 51% to 100%, and two LLPs entered the perimeter duringFY 2024.

sections.title: Growth quality, reinvestment and backlog
sections.text: March 2026 parent unexecuted backlog₹125.33 crore spans four projects,95.78% water infrastructure; Digvijay separately discloses₹92.43 crore road backlog. These full contract amounts are not cash, guaranteed margin or wholly attributable owner value. Group land increased to₹42.2655 crore from₹20.8238, with₹18.7263 building CWIP; much of FY 2026 cash capex₹40.7861 therefore represents property investment rather than EPC machinery. Core operating EBIT excluding other income is₹13.0432 crore, versus₹19.9037 inFY 2025; reported capital return declined to 8.98%, below an analyst 12–16% capital-cost range. The post-IPO cash denominator and moving property mix make a single incremental ROIC misleading. CAP 3 reflects weak demonstrated return and unproven new-project cash realization, while infrastructure sales growth and the backlog are genuine counterevidence.

sections.title: Management, governance and execution
sections.text: The listed Shradha group controls Active; June 30 shareholding independently confirms promoter group 73.3066%, including Shradha 71.6323%, and no promoter pledge in that dated table. It is not an independently verified October holding. MD remuneration₹.072 crore and disclosed CFO/CS pay are modest, but group loans and project allocation are more material alignment questions. Parent granted₹15.5484 crore subsidiary loans duringFY 2026 with₹8.6570 outstanding; auditor says repayment schedules were not stipulated, so regularity could not be assessed, although no overdue amount was reported. These eliminate on consolidation but still matter for parent capital discipline. July shareholder approvals changed IPO uses and expanded related-party loan ceilings; approvals do not prove value creation or cash disbursement. V.S.Jakhotiya declined the next audit term due to preoccupancy; V.K.Surana was appointed forFY 2026–2030, not described as a proven dispute. Current audit/IFC are unmodified, company audit trails operated, LLPs are exempt from that reporting rule, and no group CARO qualification is reported. The August annual-report corrigendum added a missing material-subsidiary secretarial report and updated dividend instructions, not revised financial figures.

sections.title: Financial forensics, earnings and cash
sections.text: FY 2026 group PAT₹10.2841 and owner PAT₹10.2309 compare with₹13.0919 and₹9.4824 inFY 2025; owner growth alongside group decline is due to the sharp fall in minority profit. FY 2026 other income₹4.9849 includes₹2.74 FD interest,₹1.2198 nonrecurring flood-insurance recovery and₹.6682 miscellaneous income. A₹2.5 crore provision relates to an unreturned tender advance to Infrasion Construction after cancellation; an FIR is reported, not a conviction, and hoped-for recovery is not modeled. Whole-group PBT excluding all other income is₹9.7335;25–30% tax and unchanged₹.0532 minority profit gives a conservative owner sensitivity₹6.7603–7.2469, not a precise corrected attributable profit. Credit loss is retained, not automatically added back. FY 2024 final prospectus group PAT₹10.4455 reconciles to owner₹9.0825 plusNCI₹1.3630 and to PBT₹14.0617. TheFY 2025 annual comparative instead prints groupPAT₹8.8127/PBT₹12.4289 with the same owner/NCI amounts; its own comparative cash flow starts at₹14.0617. This material discrepancy is preserved, not silently resolved by choosing a preferred number. FY 2026 CFO−₹24.5132 includes₹20.6911 new FD within other financial assets; ex-placement CFO−₹3.8221, after₹3.3097 financing interest−₹7.1318. FD placement remains an economic cash use and is not freely distributable cash. FY 2025 CFO was reclassified from₹5.0784 to₹4.4788 by moving₹.5996 FD release into investing. Earlier FY 2024 CFO₹31.8829 includes debt/FD movements and capitalized-interest effects, so raw multi-yearCFO/PAT is not presented as homogeneous.

sections.title: Valuation and linked operating/property scenarios
sections.text: Official latest observed trade₹172.50 onOctober 5 implies₹259.0090 crore equity value,25.32 x ownerPAT and about 35.7–38.3 x conservative normalized owner sensitivity. This is not a current executable bid. Book owner equity₹120.4563 implies 2.15 x book, but property NRV, cash restrictions and minority rights determine realizability. The model separates EPC EBITDA from cost-based property NAV: existing land/CWIP/building inventory₹102.0099 crore is not valued again through capitalized rent. It begins with actual EPC working capital₹60.6211, debt₹80.2321 and cash₹8.237, transfers only assumed₹16.17 existing IPO deposits to usable cash, retains other₹18.8491 deposits, and adds the August₹35.712 purchase plus explicit 6% fee sensitivity once. Existing project-completion budget₹10 crore is an analyst sensitivity, not a disclosed commitment. BaseEPC growth 8/8/7/6/5%,12% EBIT margin and 6 x EBITDA/property 1 x cost yields a₹33.53 crore peak gap; terminal₹125.38 is unfunded arithmetic, not an investor return. Bull 15/15/12/10/8%,15% margin,8 x EBITDA/property 1.2 x and assumed 49.5% partner contribution still has₹12.87 crore gap. R remains NS; no rescue or valid IRR is invented. Margin/multiple and completion/FD-release sensitivities are retained.

sections.title: Bear case and permanent-loss path
sections.text: March free cash₹8.237 includes₹4.0022 cheques in hand; deposits total₹35.0191 but are not proven wholly unrestricted. Borrowings₹80.2321 include substantial demand/working-capital debt and₹4.6507 current maturities. Unbilled services jumped to₹19.9222 from₹.4468, retention is₹9.524, and billed receivables₹49.935 are mostly less than six months old. Slower certification can therefore impair liquidity before conventional aged-debtor ratios worsen. The model bear combines−25% EPC sales,6% margin,12% borrowing cost,60 extra collection days, contract-asset/retention losses,25% guarantee payout sensitivity and un-cleared-cheque stress. Peak gap₹88.30 crore and zero residual equity under 0.65 x property-cost/4 x EPC valuation are explicit stress outcomes, not a forecast bankruptcy or probability. Banks, property creditors and minority partners have claims before common owners. Asset-rich does not mean cash-survivable.

sections.title: Five-times and ten-times feasibility
sections.text: At unchanged shares,5 x/10 x equity value would require₹1,295/2,590 crore. At an illustrative 20 x owner earnings, that means roughly₹64.75/129.50 crore sustainable owner PAT, around 6.3 x/12.7 x reportedFY 2026 earnings and more against normalized earnings. Backlog₹217.76 crore across parent/subsidiary is not annual profit and carries minority, certification and funding constraints. Property appreciation or a capital-release cycle could help, but no independently appraised NAV or funded development plan supports a multibagger claim. The scenario range is intended to test assumptions, not advertise target prices.

sections.title: Monitoring and liquidity implementation
sections.text: Monitor contract certification and cash receipts against₹19.9222 unbilled work and₹9.524 retention; government/related-customer collections; the₹2.5 tender-advance recovery without counting it twice; actual land funding, partner contributions and completion budgets; IPO reallocation/deposit maturities; property sales/rental cash; debt renewal and guarantee requirements; and a signedFY 2024 comparative reconciliation. Sixty official sessionsJuly 24–October 19 contain 20 observed trading days; last 20 onlyfour. Already listed before the window, conditional zero-filling gives median turnover zero and no finite exit estimate. Even excluding all missing days, observed median is only₹364,500, requiring 27.43 trading sessions at 5% participation for₹5 lakh,68.59 at 2% and 13.72 at 10%. L 1 is therefore robust without relying solely on zero-fill.600-share lot costs₹103,500; currentSM master band₹138–207 is 20% around last₹172.50. Named NSE ASM/ESM/GSM lists show no match, not blanket clearance. No live spread/depth is known; a new₹5 lakh purchase is effectively impractical under the reference exit test. The October 19 REG 1 file, effective October 21 rather than retroactively, flags fewer than 100 unique trading PANs in the preceding 30 days and the exchange SME not-regularly-traded caution. These are implementation cautions, not proof of wrongdoing. GSM, long/short ASM and ESM fields are inactive in that forward-effective file; this is not universal clearance. L 1 is independently supported by observed turnover, not assigned mechanically from the SME caution.

sections.title: Final classification and conditional action
sections.text: Completed deep assessment: low-quality/implementation hold, not a favorable investment classification. Real EPC execution, established group access, positive owner earnings and property assets are positive. Offsetting them are concentrated demand, weak adjusted cash realization, land-heavy reinvestment, unreconciled older financial presentation and an unverified post-year-end funding bridge. BQS 3.64 and GQS 3.15 are conditional research judgments excluded from ranking; IAS NS preserves the critical return uncertainty and tradability gate. Better disclosure alone is insufficient without collections and funded property progress. Another related-party commitment unsupported by cash, or confirmed financing stress, would worsen the assessment.

sections.title: Sources, assumptions and open questions
sections.text: Sources are linked and section-specific. Final IPO restated history is used where its profit allocation and cash-flow starting profit cross-check, while the conflicting annual comparative remains visible. Old originalFY 2021/2022 units and changed consolidation scope are explicitly separate. RevisedFY 2026 annual statements were OCR-read, with main balance sheet/cash flow visually checked. June ownership is corroborated, but later promoter/pledge changes, restriction status beyond named lists, unrestrictedFD availability, actual property/partner funding, development cost and independent property appraisal remain open. Corporate announcement caches support discovery but are not evidence that no other obligations exist. Scenario partner capital, fees, completion cost, margins, multiples and NAV ratios are assumptions; statutory approvals and borrowing ceilings are not cash.
